source_sleef.algorithm: Unmodified xtanf in src/libm/sleefsimdsp.c, generated scalar dispatch and explicit AVX512 implementation. Source Estrin grouping from src/common/estrin.h; no hand fit.

source_svml.method: Unmodified source assembly compiled natively; wrapper handles last partial vector by repeating last valid lane.

commands: cc -O2 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -fPIC -shared core_math/wrapper.c core_math/acosf.c core_math/tanf.c core_math/atanf.c -lm -o libcore_probe.so
execution_gate: Native Cura x86 AVX512 only; one process, one build job, threads1, verify symbol names against generated sleef.h before run, no Torch imports or proprietary runtime needed. Retain compiler/build/link logs, raw output and source/env hashes. Hash-verify local artifacts then clean only ledger-owned directory.
interpretation: This is tangent-stage isolation on774 original ASVF values and153 original scalar coefficients, not complete portable pipeline. Neither bit agreement alone nor fixing the four selected rows is sufficient. Preserve all boundary masks; if failed, report rejection without per-input blending. Native results precede any portable SLEEF transcription validation.
